title: The Lantern Citadel
subtitle: A moonlit island of towers, gardens and hidden stories
layout: Central great hall flanked by four spires, east dormer wing, front cloister bridge, all on a rounded rocky island above a teal lake with distant ridges and a moon.

parts.name: Great Hall
parts.task: Long central hall, local footprint x[-7,7] z[-14,14], base y=0. Body height 13, gable roof rise 7 via geometry.gable, ridge along z. Rows of exterior Gothic lancet windows: 6 per long side, 4 per gable end, amber emissive. Buttresses: 8 vertical piers at corners and midpoints, 1.2 wide. Two chimneys at rear gable, 2 tall. Limestone #9c9589 walls, slate-blue roof. Touches towers at x=+/-7 and wing at z=14. Hotspot on central gable.

parts.name: Four Spires
parts.task: Four connected cylindrical towers at corners x=+/-10, z=+/-10. Main shaft diameter 7, height 27, plus spire 12, total 39; tallest reaches 45 above base with finial. Three smaller towers diameter 5, height 20, spire 8. Tiered shafts with 2 ledges each, window bands of 3 lancets per tier, small corner turrets diameter 1.5. Limestone shafts, slate spires, amber windows. Footprints touch hall walls. Hotspot on main spire.

parts.name: East School Wing
parts.task: East wing, local footprint x[-6,6] z[-12,12], base y=0, body height 10, gable roof rise 6. Rows of roof dormers: 8 along each slope, each with small gable and window. Ground arcade of 6 rounded arches along front z=12. Limestone walls, slate roof, amber dormer windows. Touches hall at x=-6 and courtyard at z=12. Hotspot on arcade.

parts.name: Courtyard & Bridge
parts.task: Front courtyard and bridge, local footprint x[-12,12] z[-8,8], base y=0. Cloisters: two rows of 5 vaulted arches each side, arch height 4, opening 2.5. Central bridge deck 6 wide spanning z, with 3 vaulted arches underneath. Limestone piers, slate arch caps, amber lanterns at 4 corners. Touches hall at z=-8 and wing. Hotspot on bridge center.

parts.name: Island & Cliffs
parts.task: Solid irregular rounded rock island, ground exactly local y=0, rocks extend down to y=-14. Ellipse radii 42 x 38. Continuous connected rocky sides with 12 cracks and 8 boulders, dark earth cap #3a352e, NOT limestone. No square slab or separate perimeter columns. Supports all buildings. Trees only behind and to sides, 6 trees height max 7, foliage #3a4a3a, no foreground ring. Hotspot on cliff face.

parts.name: Lake & Landscape
parts.task: Use makeWater(800) at local y=0 for the lake. Add five distant mountain silhouettes only at world z <= -200, height 15..45. No additional water planes, strips or rings. Keep the foreground clear.

parts.name: Sky Dome
parts.task: Single inward sphere radius 650 around origin, smooth blue-hour gradient via ShaderMaterial, navy #1b2a4a to warm horizon. Sparse tiny stars: 200 points, subtle. Distant moon behind castle at z=-400, soft glow. No panels, stacked planes or bands. Host owns fog and lighting; this is pure backdrop. Integrates with all parts as environment.

parts.name: Magic & Candles
parts.task: Animated tiny golden flying motif trails: 30 particles in gentle arcs around courtyard, gold #e8b34a. A few glowing floating candles: 8 small cylinders with warm emissive, drifting slowly. Don't obscure architecture, keep low density. Local coordinates relative to courtyard origin. Integrates with courtyard and hall. No physical hotspot, purely atmospheric.

parts.name: West Observatory
parts.task: West observatory: local footprint x[-6,6], z[-7,7]. Octagonal stone tower, body height 13, slate cone roof height 7. Two tiers of warm exterior windows, stone ribs, a small bronze telescope on an open side balcony. Ground meets local y=0. No buttons or lights. Hotspot on balcony.

parts.name: Lantern Gatehouse
parts.task: Low gatehouse at courtyard edge: local x[-8,8], z[-4,4]. Two square side towers height 7 with gable roofs rise 3; open central pointed arch height 5, width 4, aligned with bridge. Warm exterior windows, iron gate bars at sides, six small emissive lanterns. Keep central opening visible. Hotspot on arch.

parts.name: Boathouse and Landing
parts.task: Small lakeside landing: timber deck local y=2, x[-7,7], z[-5,5], stilts down to water y=0. Tiny boathouse with closed gable roof, one moored rowboat outside, railings and rope posts. Narrow staircase climbs toward island to local y=14 on negative z edge. No water plane, lights or buttons. Hotspot on boat.

parts.name: Terraced Garden
parts.task: Low walled garden: local x[-7,7], z[-8,8], y=0 ground. Four geometric beds, low hedges below y=1.5, gravel paths, stone benches and a small central fountain basin with subtle animated droplets. Keep heights below 4. Add two slender arch trellises, no tall trees. No buttons or lights. Hotspot on fountain.
